generation_prompt: The robot grasps the cube on the lowest shelf with its right hand, closes its fingers around the sides, and lifts it clear. It carries the cube up to the highest shelf, sets it upright, and opens its hand to leave it resting there. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Cube stands upright on the highest shelf, with blue face toward the camera and white top upward. Right hand is open and withdrawing just above/beside it; left hand remains unused. Lowest shelf is empty.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: grasps cube between thumb and fingers, lifts and transports it from lowest to highest shelf, sets it upright and releases.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open at the left body side; no contact, stabilization, transfer or support of the cube or shelf.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand transfer; no bimanual coordination or person interaction.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
